dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Mendoza Flashes Potential but Raiders Fall to 4-7 After Denver Loss
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: Despite three passing touchdowns from rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza, Las Vegas dropped to 4-7 following a 38-24 defeat to the Broncos, highlighting persistent defensive struggles that rank last in the NFL for points allowed.
bullets: Rookie QB Fernando Mendoza threw three touchdowns, including a 68-yard strike to Ashton Jeanty and a 6-yard connection to Jack Bech, but the offense faded late in the divisional loss [S6](https://www.raiders.com/video/fernando-mendoza-jack-bech-touchdown-broncos-nfl-week-11-2026-season) [S7](https://www.raiders.com/news/nfl-game-recap-fernando-mendoza-flashes-brilliance-but-raiders-fade-late-against-broncos)

Running back Ashton Jeanty provided explosive production with a 46-yard run and a 68-yard receiving score, yet the team remains league-worst in rushing EPA and yards per carry [S9](https://www.raiders.com/video/ashton-jeanty-fernando-mendoza-68-yard-touchdown-broncos-nfl-week-11-2026) [S13](https://www.raiders.com/video/ashton-jeanty-46-yard-run-broncos-nfl-week-11-2026-season)

Head Coach Klint Kubiak emphasized the need for consistency after Denver's Jonah Coleman powered a 38-point performance against a Las Vegas defense allowing 29.7 points per game [S1](https://www.raiders.com/video/klint-kubiak-postgame-presser-broncos-nfl-week-11-2026-season) [S10](https://www.espn.com/nfl/recap?gameId=401873075)

Looking ahead to Week 12 at Cleveland, the Raiders must overcome the absence of star tight end Brock Bowers (ankle) while leveraging their #1 ranked special teams units [S14](https://www.raiders.com/video/raiders-vs-broncos-full-game-highlights-nfl-week-11-2026-season)
